pr.title: Avoid live CLI rendering when stdout is redirected
pr.author: adamint

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript.Tests, Hosting.JavaScript, Hosting.JavaScrip... / Hosting.JavaScript (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: Node/Deno app fixture InitializeAsync timed out after 1 minute waiting for the app to start (Polly.Timeout.TimeoutRejectedException / TaskCanceledException). The PR only changes Aspire.Cli files (RunCommand.cs, ConsoleInteractionService.cs, CliHostEnvironment.cs) and their tests; it does not touch Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript.Tests or the Node/Deno app fixtures. This is an environmental startup timeout on a windows-latest runner, unrelated to the PR changes.
